newsitem.title: USA: Fed refrains from open-market operations.
newsitem.headline: Fed refrains from open-market operations.

text.p: The Federal Reserve Bank of New York refrained from open-market operations on Tuesday with the federal funds trading below target and two outstanding fixed system repurchase agreements in place, dealers said.
At 1130 EDT/1530 GMT, the Fed's usual intervention time, federal funds changed hands at 5-3/16 percent, below the 5-1/4-percent target.
The Fed temporarily added reserves to the banking system with seven-day fixed system repos on Thursday last week and three-day fixed system repos on Monday.
